autonomy.note: Skips approval prompts and Codex's own Linux namespace sandbox (which needs capabilities the box drops). Only ever used inside the box, where the container is the boundary.

verified.notes: The npm package @openai/codex wraps a prebuilt native Linux x64 musl program published at @openai/codex@0.171.0-linux-x64, so the lockfile pins that platform package directly and installs with scripts off. Configured through ~/.codex/config.toml (rendered as TOML) with wire_api = 'responses' pointing at the gateway, which translates /v1/responses to the engine's /v1/chat/completions; check_for_update_on_startup, analytics and remote plugin checks are off so codex exec answers through the gateway with 0 blocked proxy requests when the network is off.
